maria: Heads up — I think I found a ctx deadline propagation issue in the Go SDK when using generator streaming + auth refresh. Repro and logs below.

maria: Repro snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Generator.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for {
  chunk, err := stream.Recv()
  if err != nil { break }
  // process chunk
}
```

maria: Observed behavior: if the auth layer performs a background token refresh (401 -> refresh -> retry), the stream.Recv() call sometimes blocks past ctx deadline. goroutine count grows on repeated calls.

dan: hmm can you paste the logs around the hang?

maria: log snippet (timestamps redacted):
```
stream recv start
auth: got 401, spawning refresh goroutine
stream recv blocked waiting for frame
ctx deadline exceeded (expected)
... but stream goroutine still alive
```

maria: Seems like the HTTP roundtrip / transport refresh path spawns a goroutine that keeps a reference to the request body/response and never observes ctx cancellation, so Recv() never returns.

kevin: sounds like our auth transport is mutating the request context or using its own child context for refresh. If the transport keeps a goroutine that writes to the response reader after ctx.Done(), Recv might block on read. Two quick things to try: 1) ensure the outgoing *http.Request uses req = req.WithContext(ctx) before sending; 2) short-term workaround: call stream.Close() in a separate goroutine on ctx.Done().

jen: can you confirm if this repros with both token source implementations? (oauth refresher vs static creds)

maria: repros with oauth refresher. static creds OK. I think the refresh goroutine is the difference.

kevin: filing note — we should audit authTransport: avoid long-lived goroutines that keep io.ReadCloser open, and ensure they select on req.Context(). Also consider exposing StreamWithContext(name, ctx) helper so callers can't accidentally leak.

maria: created minimal sample under samples/go/generator/ctx-deadline-repro and a quick log and steps. Will open a PR with a failing test and proposed fix.

devexbot: Created ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/issues/432 — please add repro steps and assign.

dan: thanks, @maria — will take a look. If you push the sample I'll try the Close-on-cancel patch locally.

maria: pushed sample and initial failing test in branch fix/ctx-deadline-prop; PTAL.

kevin: nice. if the test is small we can run it in CI against the transport mocks.

jen: added to the sprint board. :+1:

dan: ack, will follow up tomorrow after local run.
